detail.title: Investigating Foundational Assumption Testing and Reasoning Failure Modes
detail.summary: This cycle evaluates recent evidence regarding safety failure modes and architectural limitations in automated reasoning systems, focusing on how model-specific behaviors affect foundational premise correction.
